title: server: implement EARS extraction
description: Implement server function to extract EARS (Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax) patterns from natural language requirements. This parser identifies and categorizes ubiquitous, event-driven, and unwanted behavior patterns.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL parse all requirement text for EARS pattern structures
THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain pattern recognition accuracy above 95%

event_driven.trigger: WHEN requirement text is submitted for extraction
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL identify and extract all EARS pattern types present

event_driven.trigger: WHEN an ambiguous pattern is detected
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL flag the ambiguity with suggested interpretations
THE SYSTEM SHALL return structured EARS output with confidence scores

unwanted.condition: IF pattern extraction confidence falls below threshold
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT include low-confidence extractions in results
unwanted.because: uncertain extractions reduce overall output quality

unwanted.condition: IF the text contains no recognizable EARS patterns
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT generate synthetic patterns
unwanted.because: fabricated patterns misrepresent the original requirements

preconditions: Input text must be in a supported language (English)
NLP models must be loaded for pattern recognition
EARS pattern templates must be configured
postconditions: Each pattern includes source text location
invariants: Extraction shall be deterministic for identical inputs
Original text shall not be modified during extraction
Pattern categorization shall follow EARS specification strictly

happy: Given text with clear ubiquitous patterns, when EARS extraction runs, then all ubiquitous patterns are correctly identified
Given text with event-driven requirements, when EARS extraction runs, then trigger-shall pairs are extracted with correct structure
Given text with unwanted behaviors, when EARS extraction runs, then condition-shall_not-because structures are properly parsed
error: Given empty input text, when EARS extraction runs, then EMPTY_INPUT error is returned
Given text in unsupported language, when EARS extraction runs, then UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE error is returned
Given malformed requirement text, when EARS extraction runs, then partial results are returned with PARSE_WARNINGS
